scope: Path confinement, bounded bundle reads, symlink/special-file refusal, stable semantic snapshot and atomic publication.
changes: Exact run-id and canonical relative-path validation; absolute, traversal, non-UTF-8, symlink and non-regular entries are rejected.
Descriptor-rooted openat traversal on Linux prevents pathname re-resolution; unsupported safe resolution paths fail closed.
Explicit entry-count, per-file byte, aggregate byte and component-depth budgets are enforced before allocations.
Attachment reads are deduplicated; semantic parsing and the digest map bind to the exact first-read bytes, with a second live-tree digest comparison against A→B→A changes.

Atomic publication uses create_new collision-safe temporaries, preserves the opened descriptor across rename, verifies identity and exact bytes, removes a rejected destination, and restores the exact captured run.json bytes on rollback.
The final follow-up transfers ownership of the bounded run.json buffer instead of cloning it.
